name: utility_seo_ga
title: Utility SEO Google Analytics
summary: Loads Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager after cookie consent.
description: Loads the id of data_settings_seo.json (google_analytics.id): a GA4 id (G-…) through gtag.js, or a Tag Manager container (GTM-…) through gtm.js. Only when the visitor allows analytics in the cookie notice (require_consent, default true); default_value decides before a choice is made. Turning analytics off later sets analytics consent to denied and clears the _ga cookies. Not loaded on localhost / *.local / *.test unless track_localhost. Rendered in the page head by page_constructor.
